steps.title: Bem-vindo: Shopping - Volume 11
steps.text: In this A2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Shopping". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: There's a 20% discount on shoes today.
The checkout line was really long today.
The price tag was still on the jacket.
